risks.how: A missing or corrupt installed WASM kernel intentionally fails closed before tool classification.
risks.cost: All Pi tool calls stop until agent-admit is reinstalled or disabled.

risks.how: Receipt persistence is best effort, so disk or permission failures can leave no audit line even though the policy decision still executes.
risks.cost: Audit evidence for affected tool calls is lost without changing allow or deny behavior.

risks.how: Non-Pi children, remote children without the extension, and Terrarium taskProof commands execute outside agent-admit.
risks.cost: Those execution paths do not produce agent-admit decisions or receipts.
